logline: A young Ethiopian couple, told their chance of a child is under one percent, refuse to stop; only at the birth do we learn who is telling the story.
audience: Draft, to be confirmed by the applicant: families and couples in Ethiopia and the diaspora who are waiting for something they have been told is unlikely
intent: Feel that a small chance is still a chance, and want to keep trying
style_block: 3D animated film frame with a painted look, sculpted rounded characters with expressive faces, hand-painted textures and visible soft brush strokes on 3D forms, painterly background, warm amber and terracotta palette with deep indigo shadows, gentle cinematic light, subject centred in frame, full-bleed picture reaching every edge

people.statement: Based on the applicant's own family story. Faces are invented drawings made from text and the narrator is a stock synthetic voice. Nobody's photograph or recording is used. Consent is recorded in ETHICS.md.

shots.reason: Meets a husband and wife as strangers, so the later reveal is a surprise
shots.image_prompt: The woman and the man as young newlyweds standing side by side in white handwoven cotton clothes with green and gold borders, shoulders touching, smiling at each other, warm afternoon garden behind
shots.motion_prompt: She smiles warmly at him, their clothes stir in a light breeze, the camera is fixed

narration.am: ሁለት በወጣትነታቸው የተጋቡ ባልና ሚስት ነበሩ፤ ልጅ እንደሚወልዱም እርግጠኛ ነበሩ።
narration.en: There were a husband and a wife who married young. They were sure they would have children.

shots.emotion: young love, shining eyes, easy open smiles

shots.reason: Time passes on the couple themselves: the same two people, the same step, no one else
shots.image_prompt: The woman and the man sitting close together on the stone doorstep of a small house, looking out over an empty quiet yard, dry leaves falling from a tree, late afternoon light
shots.motion_prompt: Dry leaves fall slowly, she gently rests her head on his shoulder, the camera is fixed

narration.am: ሆኖም አንድ ዓመት አለፈ። ከዚያም ሁለት። ከዚያም አምስት።
narration.en: But one year passed. Then two. Then five.

shots.emotion: hope slowly turning to quiet worry, tired eyes, still close to each other

transition.reason: Years pass on the same two people

shots.reason: Their waiting is active: prayer and patience
shots.image_prompt: The woman seated by candlelight at night, white shawl over her hair, eyes closed, hands pressed together near her chest, quiet prayer, dark room
shots.motion_prompt: Her lips move softly in prayer, the candle flame flickers, the camera is fixed
shots.emotion: deep longing and faith, brows slightly drawn, eyes closed

shots.reason: The bad news, held on the couple rather than the doctor
shots.image_prompt: The woman and the man seated close together in a plain consulting room, holding hands tightly, heads lowered, cool daylight from a high window
shots.motion_prompt: He slowly turns his face toward her, the camera is fixed

narration.am: ከዚያም ሐኪሙ፦ በኢትዮጵያ የመውለድ ዕድላቸው ከአንድ በመቶ በታች መሆኑን ነገራቸው።
narration.en: Then the doctor told them that in Ethiopia, their chance of having a child was less than one percent.

shots.emotion: shock and grief held in, eyes lowered, lips pressed together

shots.reason: The turn: the couple choose a question over an ending
shots.image_prompt: The woman lifting her face with a determined look toward the man beside her, warm lamp light on both faces, night window behind
shots.motion_prompt: She speaks gently, her lips moving naturally, the camera is fixed

narration.am: ብዙ ሰው እዚህ ጋር ተስፋ ይቆርጥ ነበር። እነሱ ግን ጠየቁ፦ «ሌላ የት እንሞክር?»
narration.en: Many people would have lost hope here. But they asked: “Where else can we try?”

shots.emotion: fear giving way to determination, steady eyes, lifted chin

transition.reason: One feeling grows out of the other

shots.reason: Distance made visible: far from home, the same two people
shots.image_prompt: The woman and the man seen from behind, walking hand in hand along a sunlit pale stone hillside street with olive trees, one small suitcase, morning light ahead of them
shots.motion_prompt: They walk slowly forward hand in hand, her shawl moves in the wind, the camera is fixed

narration.am: መልሱ ሩቅ ነበር፤ እስራኤል። አዲስ ሃገር፣ አዲስ ሐኪሞች፣ አዲስ ቋንቋ፣ አራት አመት።
narration.en: The answer was far away: Israel. A new country, new doctors, a new language. Four years.

shots.emotion: courage and hope, upright steady walk

shots.reason: The birth, in a hand rather than a face; it does not say yet whose life this is
shots.image_prompt: Extreme close view of a newborn baby hand with tiny fingers wrapped around one adult finger, white blanket, soft golden morning light
shots.motion_prompt: The tiny fingers slowly close around the finger, the camera is fixed

narration.en: And then… a baby was born.

shots.emotion: peace and wonder in a tender touch, nobody's face visible

shots.reason: The reveal: the narrator was the baby all along
shots.image_prompt: The woman holding a newborn baby wrapped in a white blanket against her chest, the man leaning in beside her, both looking down at the baby with tears of joy, soft golden window light
shots.motion_prompt: She smiles and gently rocks the baby, the camera is fixed
shots.emotion: overwhelming joy, tears and wide smiles

transition.reason: The small hand becomes the reveal

shots.reason: The emotional peak: the line she still says, on her face
shots.image_prompt: The woman, older now with a few silver hairs, face filling the frame, joyful eyes, mouth open speaking warmly toward the viewer, golden window light
shots.motion_prompt: She speaks warmly, her lips and jaw moving naturally, she blinks and smiles, the camera is fixed

narration.am: እናቴ ዛሬም ትላለች፦ «ሌሎች ሴቶች በዘጠኝ ወር ይወልዳሉ፤ እኔ ግን በዘጠኝ ዓመት ወለድኩ።»
narration.en: My mother still says: “Other women give birth in nine months. But I gave birth in nine years.”

shots.emotion: proud joy with the memory of hardship, warm laughing eyes

transition.reason: Many years later, the same woman

shots.reason: The family keeps growing: one child becomes three
shots.image_prompt: An older boy, a younger girl and a small boy seen from behind running together across a sunny green field, holding hands, white cotton clothes, warm golden light
shots.motion_prompt: The children run slowly forward, grass moves in the wind, the camera is fixed

narration.am: ከዚያ ታናሽ እህቴ፣ ከዚያም ታናሽ ወንድሜ ተወለዱ።
narration.en: Then my little sister was born. Then my little brother.

shots.emotion: carefree happiness in the children's running bodies

transition.reason: The children run into the story

shots.reason: The same doorstep that was empty is now full
shots.image_prompt: The woman and the man, older, sitting on the stone doorstep of a small house with two boys and one girl seen from behind around them, all close together, warm golden light
shots.motion_prompt: The family laugh softly, shoulders moving slightly, the camera is fixed

narration.am: ያ አንድ በመቶ እኔ ነበርኩ። ሁላችንም ነን።
narration.en: I was that one percent. We all are.

transition.reason: The family gathers where two people once sat

shots.reason: Turns to the viewer with the light still ahead
shots.image_prompt: A family of five seen from far behind as small figures walking together up a green hill toward a huge golden sunrise, long soft shadows, open sky
shots.motion_prompt: The family walk slowly up the hill, grass sways, sunlight grows brighter, the camera is fixed

narration.am: ዕድላችሁ አንድ በመቶ ነው ቢሏችሁ፣ አስታውሱ፦ አንድ በመቶ ዜሮ አይደለም። ተስፋ አትቁረጡ።
narration.en: If they tell you your chance is one percent, remember: one percent is not zero. Never give up.

shots.emotion: calm hope, shoulders relaxed, walking toward light

transition.reason: The light of the birth returns for the viewer

lines: Pictures, voice and music made with AI
A true family story. All faces are invented.
